name: NULLFIGHT: Bare Neural Combat
subcategory: underground / illegal combat sim / BCI limit-pushing
description: The oldest and most notorious underground neural combat circuit still running in Meridian 88, NULLFIGHT strips players of all augmentation data and combat-assist algorithms, forcing BCI-linked one-on-one fights where every hit registers as real pain at 60% fidelity — high enough to train real reflexes, high enough to cause real neurological fatigue. Matches are held in rotating Shelf locations broadcast over pirate neural feeds, with betting pools running in the tens of thousands of Quanta. The game has no developer, no studio — it's a protocol, passed hand to hand, that anyone can run.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 corporate security contractor is secretly playing NULLFIGHT to maintain combat reflexes their employer thinks they're maintaining through legal means — until they take a loss that leaves them twitching.
The NULLFIGHT protocol has been modified by someone unknown — the pain fidelity has been quietly raised to 85%, and players are getting hurt in ways that don't heal.
A Shelf kid with a genuine gift for NULLFIGHT is being scouted simultaneously by a corponation combat sports recruiter and by someone who wants their skills for something much less legal.
